# Cells off a real screen: an Ubuntu framebuffer console at 1920x1080,
# captured by an ESP-KVM and read out of the capture buffer 8 pixels at a
# time. One line per cell that had ink: the row, the column, and the 16
# rows of the cell's bitmap, one byte each, most significant bit leftmost.
#
# The console draws from the very top of the frame, which is why this is
# here: 67 rows of 16 leave 8 pixels over and the reader used to look for
# them split above and below. The font is Uni2-Fixed16, which console-setup
# loads over the one the kernel carries.
